entries.source: mir.com.my Nikkor Resources 15mm page and Roland Vink's Nikon lens serial list
entries.note: Nikon made exactly one non-AI 15mm f/5.6: the Nikkor-QD·C Auto, s/n 321001 onward from June 1973. The QD Auto without ·C never left prototype (s/n 320001-320022, 22 built). There is no separate non-Auto QD·C, so #4791 is the same product as #4792 minus the Auto suffix. The New Nikkor (#4660, 1976) and AI Nikkor (#4500, 1977) are genuine later versions and stay.
